description: Curated symbol addresses for strict fixup verification (tools/symbols.py). cs = CS offset (file offset - 0x200); ds = DGROUP offset (DS:0 = file 0x256D0). Library _TEXT publics are derived automatically from KNOWN_LIBRARY regions and are not listed here.

_main.evidence: C0S calls it (call at file 0x2FC, disp 0x013A); see tests/test_coordinates.py

N_OVERFLOW@.evidence: target of the `call` in every -N stack check (cmp [___brklvl],sp; jb +3; call N_OVERFLOW@) across all C functions; tail-jumps into C0S

___brklvl.evidence: operand of `cmp word ptr [0x9a],sp` in every -N stack check; TCC emits it as an EXTDEF ___brklvl fixup
